a delay ii[ind,toind]= DELAY FIXED (
	a ii[ind,toind], Year 1, initial a ii[ind,toind])
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

a diffusion ii[ind,toind]=
	a ii[ind,toind]
	~	Dmnl
	~	a ii[ind,toind]*(1+delta a chosen delay[ind,toind]*fraction new \
		capital[toind])
	|

a e before ESc[nrg,ind,toind]=
	a e ii[ind,toind]*E Z source share delay[nrg,ind,toind]
	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~	Energy AE by source before this period's electrification process.
	|

a e ESc[ind,toind]=
	a e ii[ind,toind]+ESc a[ind,toind]
	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~		|

a e ii[ind,toind]=
	a m e ii[ind,toind]*E Z intensity ii[ind,toind]
	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~		|

a e imp before ESc[nrg,ind,toind]=
	a e imp ii[ind,toind]*E Z source share imp delay[nrg,ind,toind]
	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~	Energy AE by source before this period's electrification process.
	|

	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~		|

	~		|

	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	a m e ESc ii[ind,toind]+a no e ii[ind,toind]+ESc a distribution[ind,toind]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	a e imp ii[ind,toind]+ESc a imp[ind,toind]
	~	TJ/Euro constant
	~		|

	a imp m e ESc ii[ind,toind]+a imp no e ii[ind,toind]+ESc a imp distribution[ind,toind
]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

a imp ii[ind,toind]=
	a post techn post electricity[ind,toind]*share imp Z Esc ii delayed w efficiency trendsall
[ind,toind]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

a imp ii m a imp ESc ii[ind,toind]=
	a imp ESc ii[ind,toind]-a imp ii[ind,toind]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

a imp m e ESc ii[ind,toind]=
	IF THEN ELSE( E Z intensity imp ii[ind,toind]=0, 0, a imp e ESc[ind,toind]/E Z intensity imp ii
[ind,toind] )
	~	Dmnl
	~	ZIDZ(a imp e ESc[ind,toind],E Z intensity imp ii[ind,toind])
	|

a imp no e ii[ind,toind]=
	a imp ii[ind,toind]*(1-E Z M share delayed post efficiency imp[ind,toind])
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

a m e ESc ii[ind,toind]=
	IF THEN ELSE( E Z intensity ii[ind,toind]=0, 0, a e ESc[ind,toind]/E Z intensity ii[
ind,toind] )
	~	Dmnl
	~	ZIDZ(a e ESc[ind,toind],E Z intensity ii[ind,toind])
	|

	~	Dmnl

	~		|

toind])

	~		|

	~		|

a post techn ii[ind,toind]= INTEG (
	in a post techn[ind,toind],
		initial a ii[ind,toind])
	~	Dmnl
	~	isso estava somando no denominador na penultima linha (16/2/23)
		+IF THEN ELSE(Time>10*Year 1,delta damage multiplier i[ind],0)
		%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
		Final da formula 4*delta damage multiplier i[ind],0)),
		%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
		IF_THEN_ELSE (Time=0,initial_a_ii[ind,toind],
		max(
		    (IF_THEN_ELSE(T_i[ind]=UFC_T_iv[ind,T1], a_diffusion_ii[ind,toind] , 
		                  IF_THEN_ELSE( \
		T_i[ind]=UFC_T_iv[ind,T2],a_delay_ii[ind,toind]*(1+delta_a_T2_ii[ind,toind]\
		), 
		                                IF_THEN_ELSE( T_i[ind]=UFC_T_iv[ind,T3] , \
		a_delay_ii[ind,toind]*(1+delta_a_T3_ii[ind,toind]) ,
		                                a_delay_ii[ind,toind]*(1+delta_a_T4_ii[ind,toind]) \
		))))
		   /
		   (1+delta_damage_multiplier_i[ind]),
		0))
	|

		*(1+ beta elasticities rqi[quintiles,ind,regions]
		*Cumulative inflation ind price to CPI ratio rqi[regions,quintiles,ind])
		
		EQUATION UNTIL 28.03.2024
		basic beta hhs i[regions,quintiles,ind]
		*(pp i cumulative elasticity inflation[ind]*pp i[ind])
		
		EQUATION UNTIL 16.02.2024
		
		basic beta hhs i[regions,quintiles,ind]
		* (1 + elast beta hhs i[ind]*(infl cumulative hhs pp i[ind] - av infl cumulative hhs \
		rq[regions,quintiles])/(euro 1/goods 1) )
		+ basic beta hhs i[regions,quintiles,ind]
		* sum(-elast beta hhs i[ind!]*(infl cumulative hhs pp i[ind!]-av infl \
		cumulative hhs rq[regions,quintiles])*basic beta hhs \
		i[regions,quintiles,ind!]/(euro 1/goods 1) )
	|

BI check=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,Euro 0,Act BI*BI per capita)*sum(pop d[inc cat
!]) - BI total
	~	
	~		|

	IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	             0,
	             Act BI*BI per capita*sum(adult population s[skill!]))
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

BI exp check=
	BI exp - BI total
	~	
	~		|

	BI per capita init*max(cumulative inflation since policy start,1)
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~		|

	5000
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~		|

	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~		|

	])
	)

	~	Total nominal consumption after electrification per industry in basic \

	ttm shares[ind]*sum((c hhs ESc pp rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]*ttm[ind!])/((1+tls[ind
	!])*(1+ttm[ind!])))
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)

	c hhs ESc pp rqi f[regions,quintiles,ind]/((1+tls[ind])*(1+ttm[ind]))+
	ttm shares[ind]*sum((c hhs ESc pp rqi f[regions,quintiles,ind!]*ttm[ind!])/((1+tls[ind\
		!])*(1+ttm[ind!])))
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~	Household nominal consumption after electrification per industry in basic \

	ttm shares[ind]*sum((c hhs ESc pp rqi m[regions,quintiles,ind!]*ttm[ind!])/((1+tls[ind\
		!])*(1+ttm[ind!])))

c hhs ESc real dom rqi after ttm[regions,quintiles,ind]=
	c hhs ESc real bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,ind]*(1+ttm[ind])
	- ttm shares[ind]*sum(c hhs ESc real bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]*ttm[ind!])
	~	Euro constant/(Year*Household)
	~		|

c hhs ESc real imp rqi after ttm[regions,quintiles,ind]=
	(c hhs ESc real bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,ind]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi[regions
,quintiles,ind]/p i[ind])*(1+ttm[ind])
	- ttm shares[ind]*sum((c hhs ESc real bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi
[regions,quintiles,ind!]/p i[ind!])*ttm[ind!])
	~	Euro constant/(Year*Household)
	~		|

	~	Euro/(Year*Household)

	~	Euro/(Year*Household)

c hhs imp real rqi bp[regions,quintiles,ind]=

,quintiles]
	~	Euro constant/Year

	~	
	~		|

	sum(c hhs rq[regions,quintiles!]*num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles!])
	~	
	~		|

c hhs rq[regions,quintiles]=
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	             c hhs rq delay[regions,quintiles]*(1+cons shocks),
	  
	(c inc hhs rq[regions,quintiles] + c w hhs rq[regions,quintiles])*
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	                1,
	IF THEN ELSE(Act Top 20 cons cap=1,
	min((c inc hhs rq[Lombardia,q4] + c w hhs rq[Lombardia,q4])/(c inc hhs rq[regions,quintiles
] + c w hhs rq[regions,quintiles]),
	1+(Time-S Time Policy start)*(Act cons red*S mpc neg/(S Time end-S Time Policy start\
		))),
	                1+(Time-S Time Policy start)*(Act cons red*S mpc neg/(S Time end-S Time Policy start
	)))
	                )
	)
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~	Household nominal consumption per region-quintile
	|

c hhs rq delay[regions,quintiles]= DELAY FIXED (
	c hhs rq[regions,quintiles], delay time, c hhs rq init[regions,quintiles])
	~	
	~		|

c hhs rq init[regions,quintiles]= INITIAL(
	(init yd hhs rq[regions,quintiles])*
	mpc hhs exog[regions](init yd hhs rq[regions,quintiles])
	)
	~	
	~		|

c hhs rqi bp[regions,quintiles,ind]=
	c hhs rqi pp[regions,quintiles,ind]/((1+tls before hh elec[ind])*(1+ttm[ind]))+
	ttm shares[ind]*sum((c hhs rqi pp[regions,quintiles,ind!]*ttm[ind!])/((1+tls before hh elec
[ind!])*(1+ttm[ind!])))
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~	Household nominal consumption per region-quintile and industry in basic \
		prices
	|

c hhs rqi bp real[regions,quintiles,ind]=
	c hhs rqi bp[regions,quintiles,ind]/p i[ind]
	~	Euro constant/Household/Year
	~	Household real consumption per region-quintile and industry in basic prices
	|

c hhs rqi pp[regions,quintiles,ind]=

	~	Euro/Household/Year
	~	Household nominal consumption per region-quintile and industry in \
		purchaser prices
	|

	~		|

	~		|

])

	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

c i bp[ind]=

!])))
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Total nominal consumption per region-quintile and industry in basic prices
	|

c i bp real[ind]=
	c i bp[ind]/p i[ind]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	Total real consumption per region-quintile and industry in basic prices
		
		IF THEN ELSE(Time=10*Year 1,
		             c real hhs i delay[ind]*(1+c19 shock cons),
		             IF THEN ELSE(Time=11* Year 1,
		                          c real hhs i delay[ind]*(1+c19 shock cons),IF THEN \
		ELSE(Time=12*Year 1,c real hhs i delay[ind
		]*(1+c19 shock cons),
		                          c real hhs pp i[ind]*pp to bp conversion factor[ind]
		                         )
		             ))
	|

c i pp[ind]=

	~	Euro/Year

		prices
	|

	,yd hhs rq delay
	[regions,quintiles])

	~	Nominal household consumption derived from income per region-quintile
		Cannot be higher than delayed income
	|

capacity almost constructed investmen nonRES[e techn]= DELAY FIXED (
	 capacity investment[e techn], capacity construction time[e techn]-Year 1, constructed capacity investment initial
[e techn])
	~	GW/Year
	~	Constructed capacity for non-RES technologies are represented by a \
		pipeline delay. The delay time is construction time-1 as it takes an \
		additional period for capacity to accumulate in the capacity stock. The \
		initial value runs until the delay time is reached, hence we assume \
		constant constructed investment within this time period. As the \
		construction time for RES is 1 year, but the minimum delay time in delay \
		fixed is TIME STEP, RES investment constructed is equal to RES investment.
	|

capacity almost constructed investment[e techn] :EXCEPT: [e wind],[e solarpv],[e solarth
]=
	capacity almost constructed investmen nonRES[e techn] ~~|
capacity almost constructed investment[e wind]=
	capacity investment[e wind] ~~|
capacity almost constructed investment[e solarpv]=
	capacity investment[e solarpv] ~~|
capacity almost constructed investment[e solarth]=
	capacity investment[e solarth]
	~	GW/Year
	~	Constructed capacity for non-RES technologies are represented by a \
		pipeline delay. The delay time is construction time-1 as it takes an \
		additional period for capacity to accumulate in the capacity stock. The \
		initial value runs until the delay time is reached, hence we assume \
		constant constructed investment within this time period. As the \
		construction time for RES is 1 year, but the minimum delay time in delay \
		fixed is TIME STEP, RES investment constructed is equal to RES investment.
	|

capacity construction time[e nec]=
	RES transition*
	(integer
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	init construction time nec+
	(final constrcution time nec-init construction time nec)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	init construction time nec)))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(integer
	(init construction time nec))
	~	Year
	~	Construction time by technology based on IEA data (IEA costs of electricity report \
		(https://www.iea.org/reports/projected-costs-of-generating-electricity-2020\
		)).
		Due to the change of mix bewtween bio and geothermal in nec, the value for nec is \
		dynamic. For simplicity we again assume a liner extrapolation over time.
		We the value for petroleum is the same as for gas and solarth same as \
		solarpv.
	|

capacity initial[e techn]=
	capacity initial MW[e techn]*MW to GW
	~	GW
	~	Data for 2010 from Jaxa-Rozen et al., 2022. Hydro include PHES and petroleum is \
		approximated using capacity factors for Italy for fossil fuels from Bolson \
		et al., 2022 and production data from Eurostat averaged between 2010 and \
		2019 due to the high fluctuation of fossil fuel capacity factors during \
		this period.
		Correction for /autoproduction: scaled by non autoproduction shares using \
		Eurostat capacity by operator shares where available (i.e. solar,hydro, \
		wind) and Eurostat energy balance production shares by operator as proxy \
		for other technologies
	|

capacity initial MW[e techn]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'electricity', 'cap_init*' )
	~	MW
	~	Data for 2010 from Jaxa-Rozen et al., 2022. Hydro include PHES and \
		petroleum is approximated using capacity factors for Italy for fossil \
		fuels from Bolson et al., 2022 and production data from Eurostat averaged \
		between 2010 and 2019 due to the high fluctuation of fossil fuel capacity \
		factors during this period.
	|

capacity investment[e techn]=
	max(min(capacity investment desired[e techn],scale constraint multiplier*capacity max investment scale
[e techn]),0)*financial constraint factor electricity
	~	GW/Year
	~	Actual capacity investment. Desired investment is constrained by potential limited \
		financial resources allocated to the technology and a scale expansion \
		constrained. Both constraints can be switched off/on.
		max(min(min(capacity investment desired[techn],scale constraint multiplier*capacity \
		max investment scale[techn]),financial constraint multiplier
		*financial constraint technologies allocated[techn]/capacity investment \
		costs per unit capacity[techn]),0)
	|

capacity investment costs per unit capacity[e techn]=
	capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e techn]*capacity learning effect
[e techn]
	~	Euro constant/GW
	~		|

	1.63877e+09 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e gas]=
	5.71612e+08 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e nuclear]=
	3.58566e+09 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e hydro]=
	RES transition*
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	init per unit inv costs hydro+
	(final per unit inv costs hydro-init per unit inv costs hydro)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	init per unit inv costs hydro))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(init per unit inv costs hydro) ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e wind]=
	1.98038e+09 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e petroleum]=
	9.48875e+08 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e solarpv]=
	4.03995e+09 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e solarth]=
	4.03995e+09 ~~|
capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e nec]=
	RES transition*
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	init per unit inv costs nec+
	(final per unit inv costs nec-init per unit inv costs nec)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	init per unit inv costs nec))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(init per unit inv costs nec)
	~	Euro constant/GW
	~	Investment costs per GW for years closest to 2010 from Jaxa Rozen et al., 2022 in \
		EUR/GW.
		Due to the change of mix bewtween bio and geothermal in nec and between PHS, Dam and \
		RoR in Hydro, the value for nec is dynamic. For simplicity we again assume \
		a liner extrapolation over time. Note that this dynamic is absent of any \
		learning effects, which is why it takes place in the 'initial' costs.
		We assume solarth is same as solarpv.
		
		Adjusted to 2010 Euros using WIOD 2016 exchange rates and core consumter \
		price inflation from Ha et al. (2023). For values from different years we \
		use capacity values and learning rates both from Jaxa-Rozen et al. (2022) \
		to obtain cost values for 2010.
	|

capacity learning effect[e techn]=
	(ZIDZ(smooth(total capacity[e techn],scale impacts adjustment time),total capacity init
[e techn]))^IF THEN ELSE( total capacity[e techn]>0, capacity learning rate beta[e techn
], 0 )
	~	Dmnl
	~	The fractional impact of learning effects on investment costs. We use a \
		common learning curve formulation with capacity driving improvements and a \
		smooth function to reflect that learning effects don't immediately \
		materialise with added capacity, but slowly evolve over time.
	|

	-0.125006 ~~|

	-0.217591 ~~|

	0.0143553 ~~|

	-0.217591 ~~|

	-0.37707 ~~|
capacity learning rate beta[e solarth]=
	-0.37707 ~~|
capacity learning rate beta[e nec]=
	RES transition*
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	learning rate beta nec init+
	(learning rate beta nec final-learning rate beta nec init)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	learning rate beta nec init))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(learning rate beta nec init)
	~	Dmnl
	~	Learning rate expression exponentials calculated from learning rates from given by \
		Jaxa Rozen et al.,2022.
		Due to the change of mix bewtween bio and geothermal in nec, the value for nec is \
		dynamic. For simplicity we again assume a liner extrapolation over time.
		We assume the value for solarth is the same as solarpv.
	|

capacity max investment scale[e techn]=
	max(max scale increase[e techn]*smooth(production capacity[e techn],scale impacts adjustment time
),min max scale increase)
	~	GW/Year
	~	The maximum amount that capacity can increase within a year due to limited \
		production capabilities. This reflects, capital stock expansions are \
		limited by current infrastructure on the ground and that the larger the \
		capacity is, the larger its absolute increase can be due to more expansive \
		infrastructure. The smooth function reflects that this infrastructure does \
		not immediately materialise with added capacity, but slowly builds up over \
		time.
	|

	~	Euro constant
	~		|

	IF THEN ELSE(min delta a[toind]=sum(a T iiv[ind!,toind,T2]),2,
	IF THEN ELSE(min delta a[toind]=sum(a T iiv[ind!,toind,T3]),3,
	IF THEN ELSE(min delta a[toind]=sum(a T iiv[ind!,toind,T4]),4,
	1)))
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

capital productivity dynamic[ind]=
	initial cap prod i[ind]
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~	capital productivity moves in line with production efficiency but does not fall
		max(capital productivity dynamic delay[ind],
		initial cap prod i[ind]*min(ZIDZ(initial unit int dem i[ind],unit intermedite demand \
		i
		[ind])
		,1+maximum capital productivity growth
		))
	|

	capital productivity dynamic[ind], Year 1, initial cap prod i[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

case1 i[ind]=
	(1-draw T2 i[ind])*(1-draw T3 i[ind])*(1-draw T4 i[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~	only T1 is available
	|

case2 i[ind]=
	draw T2 i[ind]*(1-draw T3 i[ind])*(1-draw T4 i[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~	T1 and T2 available
	|

case3 i[ind]=
	draw T3 i[ind]*(1-draw T2 i[ind])*(1-draw T4 i[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~	T1 and T3 available
	|

case4 i[ind]=
	draw T2 i[ind]*draw T3 i[ind]*(1-draw T4 i[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~	T1, T2 and T3 available
	|

case5 i[ind]=
	(1-draw T2 i[ind])*(1-draw T3 i[ind])*draw T4 i[ind]
	~	Dmnl
	~	T4 available
	|

case6 i[ind]=
	draw T2 i[ind]*(1-draw T3 i[ind])*draw T4 i[ind]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

case7 i[ind]=
	(1-draw T2 i[ind])*draw T3 i[ind]*draw T4 i[ind]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

cb gs[gender,skill]=
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	sum(Pop 014 g[gender!]) * (sum(Working age population cgs[cohorts!,gender,skill]) / 
	sum(Working age population cgs[cohorts
	!,gender!,skill!])) * benefit per child*CPI,
	(1-Act BI) * sum(Pop 014 g[gender!]) *max(0,sum(Working age population cgs[cohorts!,
	gender,skill]) / sum(Working age population cgs
	[cohorts!,gender!,skill!])) * benefit per child*CPI
	))
	~	Euro/Year
	~	child benefits received by group
		
		(1+CPI fw cumulative inflation delay)
	|

	ZIDZ(cb gs[gender,skill],sum(Working age population cgs[cohorts!,gender,skill]))
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~	Child benefits per capita per gender and skill
	|

!])

	,quintiles]*CPI*(1-Act BI))

	IF THEN ELSE(capacity construction time[e techn]=1,
	new capacity investment costs[e techn],
	completely financed as delay[e techn]
	)
	~	Euro constant/(Year*Year)
	~	We assume a linear expense schedule of investment costs over the time of \
		construction.

		time of 1 year or less, the formulation avoids the delay.

constructed capacity investment initial[e techn]=
	constructed capacity investment initial MW[e techn]*MW to GW
	~	GW/Year
	~	Constructed capacity additions in 2010 by technology. Source: Jaxa-Rozen et al., \
		2022. For these initial values, we ignore depreciation, i.e. these values \
		are simply the difference between capacity 2011 and 2010 (max 0, since \
		linear depreciation of initial capital is assumed).
		Correction for autoproduction: scaled by non autoproduction shares using \
		Eurostat capacity by operator shares where available (i.e. solar,hydro, \
		wind) and Eurostat energy balance production shares by operator as proxy \
		for other technologies
	|

		2022. For these initial values, we ignore depreciation, i.e. these values \
		are simply the difference between capacity 2011 and 2010 (max 0, since \
		linear depreciation of initial capital is assumed).
		Correction for autoproduction: scaled by non autoproduction shares using \
		Eurostat capacity by operator shares where available (i.e. solar,hydro, \
		wind) and Eurostat energy balance production shares by operator as proxy \

	depreciation K i[public]*price capital pp i[public]
	+depreciation K i[health]*price capital pp i[health]
	+depreciation K i[education]*price capital pp i[education]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

	total tls households+sum(c ESc nom bp dom i[ind!])+sum(c ESc nom bp imp i[ind!])+sum
(shortfall c nom
	[ind!])-sum(c ESc pp i[ind!])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

	~	Person/Year

	~	Dmnl
	~	1-(Time/30)^0.5
		1-(Time/(40*Year 1))^0.5

	~		|

corp tax i[ind]=
	max(corp tax rate*(profits post interest i[ind]-depreciation K i[ind]*price capital pp i
[ind]),0)
	~	Euro/Year
	~	corporate income tax paid by industry
	|

corp tax i effective[ind]=
	corp tax i rents[ind]+corp tax selfemp i[ind]+corp tax non MI i[ind]
	~	
	~		|

corp tax i rents[ind]=
	max(rental tax effective*profits postimpr rents share i[ind]*(profits post interest i
[ind]-depreciation K i[ind]*price capital pp i
	[ind]),0)
	~	
	~		|

corp tax non MI i[ind]=
	max(corp tax rate*profits postimpr nonMI share i[ind]*(profits post interest i[ind]-
depreciation K i[ind]*price capital pp i
	[ind]),0)
	~	
	~		|

corp tax rate=
	min(max tax rate,
	IF THEN ELSE(Time>S Time Policy start:AND:Act additional expense compensation=1,
	max(desired corporate income tax rate+financing gap financial/corporate tax base delayed
,corp tax rate from 2017
	),
	
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<7,"corp tax rate 2010-2016",corp tax rate from 2017)
	*IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,1,
	                1+min(S Time end-S Time Policy start,Time-S Time Policy start)*(S corp tax rate
	/(S Time end-S Time Policy start))
	                )
	))
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

"corp tax rate 2010-2016"=
	0.275
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

corp tax rate from 2017=
	0.24
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	~		|

CPI=
	sum(price index pp i[ind!]*price weights base previous year pp i[ind!])
	~	Euro/Euro constant
	~	Consumer Price Index using purhcaser prices and updated consumption \
		weights from the previous year
	|

	sum(price index pp i[ind!] * price weights current period decile[deciles,ind!])
	~	
	~		|

	CPI decile[deciles]/initial CPI decile[deciles]
	~	
	~		|

	1
	~	Euro/Euro constant
	~		|

	~	Euro/Euro constant

		updated consumption weights from the previous year
	|

CT redistrib d[inc cat]=
	ZIDZ((tls carbon costs paid to domestic government-reimbursed carbon costs total)*(eligible CT d
[inc cat]*pop d[inc cat
	]),sum(eligible CT d[inc cat!]*pop d[inc cat!]))
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Total income from carbon tax redistribution per individual category, total \
		carbon tax revenue is distributed among eligible individual categories \
		proportionally to their population shares
	|

CT redistrib per capita d[inc cat]=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,0,Act CT redistrib*(ZIDZ(CT redistrib d[inc cat
],pop d[inc cat])))
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~	Per capita income from net tax redistribution net of carbon tax payments per \
		individual category
		
		New proposed equation:
		ZIDZ(((Act CT redistrib* CT redistrib d[inc cat]) - Carbon tax hh per capita d[inc \
		cat]),pop d[inc cat])*People 1
		
		Equation until 15/04/2024
		ZIDZ((Act CT redistrib* (CT redistrib d[inc cat] - Carbon tax hh d[inc \
		cat])),pop d[inc cat])*People 1
	|

CT redistrib per capita d delay[inc cat]= DELAY FIXED (
	 CT redistrib per capita d[inc cat], Year 1, 0* euro 1)
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~	Per capita income from net tax redistribution net of carbon tax payments \
		per individual category, lagged
	|

	regions,inc cat!,quintiles])
	~	
	~	Net income from carbon tax (payments - redistribution), total nominal \
		value per region-quintile
	|

electricity demand expected[electricity technologies]=
	IF THEN ELSE(
	constrained factor delayed[electricity ind]<1 :AND: y FC delayed[electricity ind]<y FE delayed
	[electricity ind],
	
	(1-Electrification)*unconstrained electricity demand expected[electricity technologies
]+
	Electrification*electricity demand expected electrification unconstrained[electricity technologies
],
	
	(1-Electrification)*electricity demand expected constrained[electricity technologies
]+
	Electrification*electricity demand expected electrification[electricity technologies
]
	)
	~	(GW*h)/Year
	~	If capital constraint is binding, capital investment is determined by \
		unconstrained expected demand as it plays role in alleviating constraint. \
		If the labour constraint is binding, investment is determined by the \
		constrained expected demand, since investment does not help to alleviate \
		the constraint.
	|

electricity demand expected by technology[e techn] :EXCEPT:    [e gas]=
	electricity generation expected[e techn]*expected electricity demand technology share
[e techn,e techn] ~~|

[e gas,e gas]+expected production share g2p[e gas])
	~	GW*h/Year
	~		|

electricity demand expected constrained[electricity technologies]=
	electricity demand delayed*(1+electricity demand expected trend*(1+expectation horizon technology
	[electricity technologies]))
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	The expected electricity demand based on trend based expectations. The \
		expectations adjustment time is added to the expectation horizon in the \
		exponent, as we use the perceived value as a basis. However, the perceived \
		value is already delayed by the expectations adjustment time, which is why \
		we add this time perdiod in the exponent. We simplify by ignoring \
		compounding of the growth rate, but as the time horizon is short, this is \
		a reasonable approximation.
	|

electricity demand expected electrification[electricity technologies]=
	(electricity demand delayed+expected electrified[electricity technologies]*TJ to GWh
	)*(1+g GDP smoothed delayed)^(1+expectation horizon technology
	[electricity technologies])
	~	GW*Hour/Year
	~		|

electricity demand expected electrification unconstrained[electricity technologies]=
	(unconstrained electricity demand delayed+expected electrified[electricity technologies
	]*TJ to GWh
	)*(1+g GDP smoothed delayed)^(1+expectation horizon technology
	[electricity technologies])
	~	GW*Hour/Year
	~		|

electricity demand expected trend=
	(electricity demand perceived-electricity demand perceived delayed)/electricity demand perceived delayed
/expectations adjustment time
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~	The trend formed in the expectation formation for the electricity demand.
	|

electricity demand perceived= INTEG (
	electricity demand perceived adjustment,
		initial electricity demand)
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	Smoothed electricity demand for expectation formation.
	|

electricity demand perceived adjustment=
	(electricity demand-electricity demand perceived)/expectations adjustment time
	~	GW*h/Year/Year
	~	Adjustement of perceived electricity demand w.r.t. to actual observed \
		electricity demand.
	|

electricity demand perceived delayed= INTEG (
	electricity demand perceived delayed adjustment,
		initial electricity demand)
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	Smoothed electricity demand for expectation formation delayed, to \
		calculate expectation trend.
	|

electricity demand perceived delayed adjustment=
	(electricity demand perceived-electricity demand perceived delayed)/expectations adjustment time
	~	GW*h/Year/Year
	~	Adjustement of perceived electricity demand delayed w.r.t. to electricity \
		demand perceived.
	|

emissions per output electricity expected=
	emissions per output electricity delayed*(1+emissions per output electricity expected trend
	*expectation horizon)
	~	tCO2eq/Euro constant
	~	The expected electricity demand based on trend based expectations. The \
		expectations adjustment time is added to the expectation horizon in the \
		exponent, as we use the perceived value as a basis. However, the perceived \
		value is already delayed by the expectations adjustment time, which is why \
		we add this time perdiod in the exponent. We simplify by ignoring \
		compounding of the growth rate, but as the time horizon is short, this is \
		a reasonable approximation.
	|

	~	Dmnl/Year

energy poverty gap rq[regions,quintiles]=
	IF THEN ELSE(energy spending share rq[regions,quintiles]-energy poverty line>=0,
	energy spending share rq[regions,quintiles]-energy poverty line,0)
	~	
	~		|

energy poverty hhs=
	energy poverty rate*sum(num hhs rq delayed[regions!,quintiles!])
	~	
	~		|

energy poverty line=
	(1+relative threshold energy poverty/100)*average energy spending share
	~	
	~		|

energy poverty rate=
	sum(hhs in energy poverty rq[regions!,quintiles!]*num hhs delayed shares rq[regions!\
		,quintiles
	!])
	~	
	~		|

energy spending share rq[regions,quintiles]=
	(sum((c hhs ESc nom bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi[regions\
		,quintiles,ind!])*E C M share i
	[ind!])
	+c hhs ESc nom bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,gas ind]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi[regions\
		,quintiles,gas ind]
	+c hhs ESc nom bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,heat ind]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi[regions\
		,quintiles,heat ind]
	+sum((c hhs ESc nom bp dom rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]+c hhs ESc nom shortfall rqi[regions\
		,quintiles,ind!])*(direct ucc bp nom[ind!]+embedded ucc bp nom[ind!]))
	 
	 
	+sum(c hhs ESc nom bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]*E C M imp share i[ind!])
	+c hhs ESc nom bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,gas ind]
	+c hhs ESc nom bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,heat ind]
	+sum(c hhs ESc nom bp imp rqi[regions,quintiles,ind!]*(direct ucc bp nom[ind!]+embedded ucc bp nom\
		[ind!]))
	)

	IF THEN ELSE(Time<=13,0.022,
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<=17,0.043,
	0.044)))
	~	Dmnl
	~	"A reduction factor of 1.74% per year applied until 2020. Starting in 2021, the \
		factor increased to 2.2% per year. Following the 2023 revision of the ETS \
		Directive, the EU ETS cap is set to bring emissions down by 62% by 2030 \
		compared to 2005 levels. To achieve this, the reduction factor has been \
		increased to 4.3% per year over the period 2024-2027 and to 4.4% per year \
		from 2028." 
		https://climate.ec.europa.eu/eu-action/eu-emissions-trading-system-eu-ets/eu-ets-emis\
		sions-cap_en
		
		before:

	RES transition*expected capacity factortransition[e techn,electricity technologies]
	+(1-RES transition)*expected capacity factorno transition[e techn,electricity technologies
]
	~	Dmnl
	~	For the first years we use data and subsequently linearly interpolate from \
		the value of the last year we have data to final values from the scenario \
		for technologies that are being used throughout. We interpolate until 2049 \
		as these are expected values so that the current values are given by the \
		final scenario values in 2050. For technologies that are being phased-out \
		(i.e. coal and petroleum), we use maximum capacity factors assuming that \
		flexibility needs are mainly covered by other technologies like gas. This \
		will also work towards no new investment in these technologies which \
		aligns with historic values of petroleum capacity and the phaseout year of \
		coal in 2025.
	|

expected capacity factor lookup[e techn,electricity technologies]=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time+expectation horizon technology[electricity technologies]-Year 1+initial year
<=last year lookup capacity factor,
	
	lookup capacity factor[e techn](Time+expectation horizon technology[electricity technologies
]-Year 1+initial year),
	
	lookup capacity factor[e techn](last year lookup capacity factor))
	~	Dmnl
	~	Since the current values are used to plan investment (i.e. future capital \
		stock), i.e. they represent an expectation, we shift the lookup by one \
		year. Thus, production shares for 2011 are drawn in 2010 to plan \
		production for 2011.

	~	Dmnl [0,1,1]
	~	0 - no bottom-up integration: Z,i,finance determined from input output
		1 - bottom-up integration: Z,i,finance from financial module.
	|

financial income tax base=
	sum(GFI rq[regions!,quintiles!])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

financial income tax base delayed= DELAY FIXED (
	financial income tax base, Year 1, 1)
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

financial income tax rate=
	min(
	max tax rate,
	IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start:AND:Act additional expense compensation=1,
	max(desired financial income tax rate+financing gap corporate/financial income tax base delayed
	,financial income tax rate from 2014)
	,
	
	IF THEN ELSE(Time<4*Year 1, "financial income tax rate 2010-2013", financial income tax rate from 2014
	)*IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	                1,
	                1+min(S Time end-S Time Policy start,Time-S Time Policy start)*(Act fin tax
	*S fintax/(S Time end-S Time Policy start))
	                )
	))
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

"financial income tax rate 2010-2013"=
	0.2
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

financial income tax rate from 2014=
	0.26
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

Financial industry revenue i[ind]=
	debt repayment i[ind]+interest payment i[ind]
	~	Euro [0,?]
	~		|

financing gap corporate=
	corporate tax base delayed*max(desired corporate income tax rate-max tax rate,0)
	~	
	~		|

financing gap financial=
	financial income tax base delayed*max(desired financial income tax rate-max tax rate
	,0)
	~	
	~		|

findem imp real=
	sum(final demand imp i[ind!]/p i[ind!])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

firms capital=
	sum(I demand nom i[ind!])-I gov
	-change in loans
	-sum(profit transfers capital[ind!])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

firms current=
	sum(y nom i[ind!])
	-sum(z demand i[ind!])
	
	
	-sum(GWB i[ind!])
	-sum(soc sec contr employer gis[gender!,ind!,skill!]*L gis[gender!,ind!,
	skill!])
	
	-sum(interest payment i[ind!])
	-sum(corp tax i effective[ind!])
	
	-sum(profit transfers capital[ind!])
	-profit transfers household
	-government gross profits
	
	+sum(ets profits impact[ind!])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

fiscal rule growth gov c=
	0.03
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~		|

flex deficit production[e techn]=
	ALLOCATE BY PRIORITY(flex deficit production potential[e techn], priority elec[e techn
] , ELMCOUNT(e techn), priority width
	 , flexible deficit)
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	Allocation of flexible deficit production to technologies.
	|

flex deficit production potential[e techn]=
	max(0,deficit production potential[e techn]*flexibility share techn[e techn])
	~	GW*Hour/Year
	~	Flexible excess production capacities by technology.As with the load, for \
		simplicity we assume that the excess capacity has the same flexibility \
		features as overall capacity.
	|

flex share production=
	flexibility share load base-sum(VRES share[e techn!]*flexibility share techn[e techn
!])
	~	Dmnl
	~	The need for flexible dispatch is given by the flexibility needs of the \
		load and increases with VRES share, according to coefficients in Sullivan \
		et al., 2013. In terms of RES share here we only consider RES production \
		directly fed into the grid, as stored production does not exhibit these \
		issues.
	|

flex share production delayed= DELAY FIXED (
	flex share production, TIME STEP, flexibility share load base)
	~	Dmnl
	~	The share of production that needs to be flexible delayed by the minimum \
		delay time in order to avoid circular equations.
	|

flexibility share load base=
	0.532551
	~	Dmnl
	~	The fraction of load that needs to be produced flexibly due to demand \
		fluctuations. Own calculations from loadcurves in Jaxa Rozen et al., 2022.
	|

flexibility share techn[e coal]=
	0.15 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e gas]=
	0.5 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e hydro]=
	0.5 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e nuclear]=
	0 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e petroleum]=
	0.3 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e solarpv]=
	-0.05 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e solarth]=
	0 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e wind]=
	-0.08 ~~|
flexibility share techn[e nec]=
	RES transition*
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	init flex share nec+
	(final flex share nec-init flex share nec)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	init flex share nec))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(init flex share nec)
	~	Dmnl
	~	Flexibility coefficients for technologies based on Sullivan et al. (2013) and \
		Carrara and Marangoni (2017).
		Due to the change of mix bewtween bio and geothermal in nec, the value for \
		nec is dynamic. For simplicity we again assume a liner extrapolation over \
		time.
	|

flexible deficit=
	total storage discharge deficit
	+flex share production delayed*max(generation deficit-total storage discharge deficit
,0)
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	total deficit generation must cover flexible electricity at least at the \
		amount of storage shortfall. if there is generation deficit exceeding of \
		storage shortfall, we assume that its flexibility characteristics are the \
		same as in the overall load
	|

	ZIDZ(electricity sector production structure[ind]-a i delay[ind],a i delay[ind])
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

g a i electricity delayed[ind]= DELAY FIXED (
	g a i electricity[ind], TIME STEP, initial g a i electricity)
	~	Dmnl
	~	in order to avoid simultaneous equations (A -> output -> electricity \
		demand -> electricity production structure -> A), we delay the impact of \
		the electricity production structure by the minimal amount

g a ii iteration[ind,toind,iteration]=
	RANDOM NORMAL(
	min delta a ii[ind,toind], 
	max delta a ii[ind,toind],
	median delta a ii[ind,toind], 
	sd delta a ii[ind,toind] , seed )
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	~	Dmnl
	~	*initial_a_ii[ind,toind]

		max_delta_a_ii[ind,toind]+sd_delta_a_ii[ind,toind] , 
		mean_delta_a_ii[ind,toind]+sd_delta_a_ii[ind,toind] , sd_delta_a_ii[ind,toind] , \
		seed )
		*a_delay_ii[ind,toind]
	|

	~	sum(final demand real i[ind!]*pp i init[ind!])-sum(Z imp real i[ind!]*pp i \
		init[ind!])

	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

		*pp i init[ind!]

GFCF real i[ind] :EXCEPT:                             [public],[education],[health],[
electricity ind]=
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	GFCF real i delay[ind]*(1+inv shocks),
	min(I desired i[ind],I max i[ind])
	) ~~|
GFCF real i[public]=
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	GFCF real i delay[public]*(1+inv shocks),
	I desired i[public]
	) ~~|
GFCF real i[education]=
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	GFCF real i delay[education]*(1+inv shocks),
	I desired i[education]
	) ~~|
GFCF real i[health]=
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	GFCF real i delay[health]*(1+inv shocks),
	I desired i[health]
	) ~~|
GFCF real i[electricity ind]=
	IF THEN ELSE(electricity module switch=0,
	IF THEN ELSE(activated c19 inv shocks=1,
	GFCF real i delay[electricity ind]*(1+inv shocks),
	min(I desired i[electricity ind],I max i[electricity ind])
	),
	
	electricity module switch*monetary investment)
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	actual GFCF real
		
		IF THEN ELSE(Time=10 :OR: Time=11,
		GFCF real i delay[ind]*(1+c19 shock inv),
		min(I desired i[ind],I max i[ind])
		)

gov c dom nom i[ind]=
	(1 - share imp gov i[ind])*gov c nom i[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

	share imp gov i[ind]*gov c nom i[ind]
	+Act electrification costs paid by gov*electrification demand imp[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

gov c nom i[ind]=
	gov c real i[ind]*p i[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

gov c real delay[ind]= DELAY FIXED (
	desired gov real i[ind], Year 1, init gov c real[ind])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	Note that we delay with the desired government consumption, since we \
		assume the output constraint has no longer lasting impact on government \
		consumption.,
	|

gov c real health edu per capita=
	(gov c real i[education]+gov c real i[health])/population total
	~	Euro constant/(Year*Person)
	~		|

	TREND(gov c real health edu per capita, 1 , 0 )
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

gov c real health edu per capita growth delay=
	DELAY FIXED(gov c real health edu per capita growth, 1 , 0 )
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

gov c real i[ind]=
	desired gov real i[ind]*ratio K FE constrained fd[ind]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	if def/GDP too high government spending can only fall
		
		(IF THEN ELSE(activated eurocrisis gov shocks=1 :OR: activated c19 shocks=1,
		gov c real delay[ind]*(1+gov shocks),
		IF THEN ELSE (def gdp delay > gov def spending trigger:AND: Act deficit rule=1,
		gov c real delay[ind]*(1-deficit rule impact),
		max(0,(1+trend impact gov c delayed[ind])*gov c real delay[ind]))))
		
		(IF THEN ELSE (def gdp delay > gov def spending trigger,
		max(0,(1+trend impact gov c delayed[ind])*gov c real delay[ind]),
		max(0,(1+trend impact gov c delayed[ind]+fiscal rule growth gov c)*gov c real \
		delay[ind])))
		*ratio K FE constrained fd[ind]
	|

	~		|

		D3 take the same value of sector D in input-output tables.

grid= INTEG (

	~	Euro constant/Year

grid depreciation=
	grid*grid depreciation rate
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	Due to the financial nature of this capital stock, we chose geometric \
		depreciation as done in the rest of the model.
	|

grid depreciation rate=
	0.0574046
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~	Depreciation rate for transmission calculated from terna 2010 \
		(https://download.terna.it/terna/0000/0057/16.pdf): Depreciation of \
		property, plant and equipment over the respective assets end of 2009. \
		Subseuquently, we scale this rate of depreciation with the fraction of \
		lifetimes of transmission and distribution line infrastructure from ETRI, \
		2014 to obtain depreciation rates for the distribution grid. Overall \
		depreciation rates are a weighted average of these two rates. As weights \
		we use costs share of transmission and distribution network costs from \
		eurostat. Here, we use the weighted average (weighted by 2010 use share of \
		household and non-household electricity use from PEFA) from 19-2021 from \
		Eurostat.
	|

grid investment=
	(RES transition*grid investment PNIEC
	+(1-RES transition)*desired investment no transition)
	*financial constraint factor electricity
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

grid investment costs=
	grid investment
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

grid investment PNIEC=
	average yearly grid investment*modelled generation to PNIEC
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

grid lifetime=
	50.8881
	~	Year
	~	Average lifetime of grid, we use a weighted average of distribution and \
		transimission line lifeteims from ETRI, 2014. As weights we use costs \
		share of transmission and distribution network costs from eurostat. Here, \
		we use the weighted average (weighted by 2010 use share of household and \
		non-household electricity use from PEFA) from 19-2021 from Eurostat.
	|

grid over electricity production share=
	(grid/initial grid value)  / (total electricity production/total electricity production intitial
) * grid share electricity production initial
	~	Dmnl
	~	grid share of electricity production, i.e. grid output/electricity production \
		output, all monetary. We assume that grid output increases proportional to \
		the grid capital:
		output grid monetary =grid/initial grid * initial output grid monetary
		output elec production monetary= physical production/initial physical production * \
		initial monetary output
		-> grid/elec production = (grid/initial grid)  / (physical \
		procution/initial physical production) * initial grid/production share \
		monetary
	|

grid production share dynamic switch=
	0
	~	Dmnl
	~	1 the grid production share (We assume that grid output increases proportional to \
		the grid capital). 
		0 the grid production share stays at its initial value.
	|

grid share electricity production initial=
	1.68952
	~	Dmnl
	~	The initial share of grid in the electricity sector, i.e. grid output/electricity \
		production output, all monetary.
		Source: Locomotion
	|

grid share electricity sector=
	grid production share dynamic switch*
	(
	1/
	((1/grid over electricity production share)+1))
	
	+(1-grid production share dynamic switch)*
	(
	1/
	((1/grid share electricity production initial)+1))
	~	Dmnl
	~	Grid share of total D1 sector, i.e. grid/(grid+elec production)
		-> grid/(grid+elec production)=1 / ((elec production/grid)+1)
	|

	Act minimum wage*(min wage average change gis[gender,ind,skill]*(Coefficient wage dispersion
	[gender,ind
	,skill]*wage gis[gender,ind,skill]))
	,0)
	
	+IF THEN ELSE(Time=S Time Policy start,
	Act maximum wage*(max wage average change gis[gender,ind,skill]*(Coefficient wage dispersion
	[gender,ind,skill]*wage gis[gender,ind,skill]))
	,0)
	
	+IF THEN ELSE(Time <S Time Policy start,0,
	Act WTR wage*delta wage WTR[gender,ind,skill])
	~	Euro/Person/Hour/Year
	~	previous formula 10/05/23
		IF THEN ELSE(wage gis[gender,ind,skill]<50*euro 1,
		wage gis[gender,ind,skill]*(omega lambda*g lamba i[ind]+omega price*inflation+ omega \
		employment*g e gs[gender,skill])
		                           +IF THEN ELSE(average wage changes gis[gender,ind,skill] \
		< -1.96* euro 1,0* euro 1, 
		0.5*min wage average change gis[gender,ind,skill]*(Coefficient wage \
		dispersion[gender,ind,skill]*wage delay gis[gender,ind,skill])),
		min(0* euro 1,wage gis[gender,ind,skill]*(omega lambda*g lamba i[ind]+ omega \
		price*inflation+omega employment[skill]*g e gs[gender,skill])+ IF THEN \
		ELSE(average wage changes gis[gender,ind,skill] < -1.96* euro 1,0* euro 1, \
		0.5*min wage average change gis[gender,ind,skill]*(Coefficient wage \
		dispersion[gender,ind,skill]*wage delay gis[gender,ind,skill])
		)))+IF THEN ELSE(Time <S Time Policy start,0* People 1 ,Act WTR wage*delta wage \
		WTR[gender,ind,skill])
		
		%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
		wage_gis[gender,ind,skill]*(
		omega_lambda*g_lamba_i[ind]+
		omega_price*inflation+
		omega_employment*(1/(1-e_gs[gender,skill]))
		                           )

	(inc tax rate 2* min(tax floor 3-tax floor 2, 
	                      max(taxable inc e gis[gender,ind,skill]-tax floor 2, 0)) +

,skill]*wage gis[gender,ind
	,skill])

max capacity factor[e techn] :EXCEPT:      [e coal],[e gas],[e nuclear],[e petroleum]
,[e nec]=
	current capacity factor[e techn] ~~|
max capacity factor[e coal]=
	0.85 ~~|
max capacity factor[e gas]=
	0.85 ~~|
max capacity factor[e nuclear]=
	1 ~~|
max capacity factor[e petroleum]=
	0.85 ~~|
max capacity factor[e nec]=
	RES transition*
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time>=S Time Policy start,
	init max cf nec+
	(final max cf nec-init max cf nec)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve
	))),
	init max cf nec))
	
	+(1-RES transition)*
	(init max cf nec)
	~	Dmnl
	~	Maximum capacity factor for non-RES from Jaxa-Rozen et al., 2022; for RES we assume \
		priority of dispatch and hence that the actual capacity factor is equal to \
		the maximum capacity factor.
		Due to the change of mix bewtween bio and geothermal in nec, the value for \
		nec is dynamic. For simplicity we again assume a liner extrapolation over \
		time.
	|

		not normalised: 0.13301638

max flex compensation[e techn]=
	((max generation by technology[e techn]-max generation a*current electricity demand technology share
[e techn])
	+reserve production potential[e techn])*max(0,flexibility share techn[e techn])
	~	GW*h/Year
	~		|

max g ee[ind]=
	2.91418
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

max generation=
	max generation a
	
	
	+min(sum(max flex compensation[e techn!])/flex share production delayed,sum(max generation by technology
[e techn!]+reserve production potential
	[e techn!])-max generation a)
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	we assume fixed fractions so that most limiting technology limits whole system and \
		not another storage technology can compensate due to their different \
		characteristics
		compensatory ramp up is either constraint by available flexible production \
		potential or if not binding by overall (i.e. baseload) production potential
	|

max generation a=
	VECTOR SELECT( current electricity demand technology share[e techn!] , max generation a technology
[e techn!], 
	0 , 8,1 )
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	Min of all technologies that have a non-zero production share.
		http://vensim.com/documentation/fn_vector_select.html
	|

max generation a technology[e techn]=
	ZIDZ(max generation by technology[e techn],current electricity demand technology share
[e techn])
	~	GW*h/Year
	~	max demand being met by generation 
		we assume fixed fractions so that most limiting technology limits whole \
		system and not another storage technology can compensate due to their \
		different characteristics
	|

	~		|

mean wage g[gender]=
	(sum(wage gis[gender,ind!,skill!]*actual hours i[ind!]*L gis[gender,ind!,skill!]))/
	(sum(actual hours i[ind!]*L gis[gender,ind!,skill!]))
	~	Euro/(Hours*Person)
	~		|

	(sum(wage gis[gender,ind!,skill]*actual hours i[ind!]*L gis[gender,ind!,skill]))/
	(sum(actual hours i[ind!]*L gis[gender,ind!,skill]))
	~	Euro/(Hours*Person)
	~		|

	(sum(actual hours i[ind!]*L gis[gender!,ind!,skill]))
	~	Euro/(Hours*Person)
	~		|

min wage level=
	min wage level init*max(cumulative inflation since policy start,1)
	~	Euro
	~	10
	|

min wage level init=
	10
	~	Euro/(Hours*Person)
	~		|

Minimum Wage Value=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time <S Time Policy start,0,Act minimum wage * min wage level)
	~	Euro/Person/Hour
	~		|

miscalculated check=
	total miscaulated ETS costs-
	(total paid prod side-total cc)
	~	
	~		|

mission:
	m1,m2,m3,m4,m5,m6
	~	
	~		|

mixed income checks1=
	sum(share of selfemp capital income i[ind!])
	~	
	~		|

mixed income per capita d[inc cat]=
	Total mixed income distributed to households*People 1/sum(pop d[inc cat!])
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~	sum(total mixed income r[regions!])*People 1/sum(pop d[inc cat!])
	|

Mixed income rents=
	sum(mixed income rents r[regions!])
	~	
	~	1: sum(mixed income rents r[regions!])
		2: Initial mixed income 2*Initial rents share of mixed income*(p i[realestate]/p \
		init i alt)
		3: sum(Mixed income rents rq[regions!,quintiles!])
	|

mixed income rents r[regions]=
	initial mixed income r[regions]*rent shares r[regions]*(p i[realestate]/p init i alt
)
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

mixed income rq[regions, quintiles]=
	(total mixed income r[regions]/sum(total mixed income r[regions!]))*
	Total mixed income distributed to households*mixed income rq shares[regions,quintiles
]
	~	
	~	1: (total mixed income r[regions]/sum(total mixed income r[regions!]))*
		Total mixed income distributed to households*mixed income rq \
		shares[regions,quintiles]
		2: Total mixed income distributed to households*mixed income rq shares \
		2[regions,quintiles]
		3. (Total mixed income rq[regions,quintiles]/sum(Total mixed income \
		rq[regions!,quintiles!]))
		*Total mixed income distributed to households
		
		
		Mixed income, total nominal value per region-quintile
		Previous: until 21/01/2026
		total mixed income r[regions]*mixed income rq shares[regions,quintiles]
		
		Previous:
		Mixed income shares hhs rq[regions,quintiles]*mixed income total
	|

mixed income rq hhs[regions,quintiles]=
	mixed income rq[regions,quintiles]/ num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles]
	~	
	~		|

mixed income rq shares[regions,quintiles]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'regions', 'profits_nifi_shares')
	~	
	~		|

Mixed income selfemp=
	sum(mixed income selfemp r[regions!])
	~	
	~	1: sum(mixed income selfemp r[regions!])
		2: VA*Mixed income selfemp to VA ratio
		3: sum(Mixed income selfemp rq[regions!,quintiles!])
	|

mixed income selfemp r[regions]=
	GWB r[regions]*mixed income selfemp to labour income ratio r[regions]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

mixed income selfemp to labour income ratio r[regions]=
	(1-rent shares r[regions])*initial mixed income r[regions]/initial GWB r[regions]
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

mixed income share=
	sum(mixed income rq[regions!,quintiles!])/sum(yd pre hh tax rq[regions!,quintiles!])
	~	
	~		|

modelled generation to PNIEC=
	(electricity generation expected[e distribution]/modelled generation to PNIEC initial
)/electricity generation PNIEC
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

modelled generation to PNIEC initial=
	initial expected generation/electricity generation PNIEC lookup(initial year)
	~	GW*h/Mtoe
	~		|

monetary capital= INTEG (
	monetary investment-monetary depreciation,
		initial grid value+
		sum(init storage capacity[storage technologies!]*storage investment costs per capacity initial
[storage technologies!])
		+
		sum(capacity initial[e techn!]*capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[
e techn!]))
	~	Euro constant
	~		|

monetary capital storage[storage technologies]= INTEG (
	monetary investment storage[storage technologies]-monetary depreciation storage[storage technologies
],
		init storage capacity[storage technologies]*storage investment costs per capacity initial
[storage technologies])
	~	Euro constant
	~		|

monetary capital techn[e techn]= INTEG (
	monetary investment techn[e techn]-monetary depreciation techn[e techn],
		capacity initial[e techn]*capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e techn
])
	~	Euro constant
	~		|

monetary depreciation=
	grid depreciation+sum(monetary depreciation storage[storage technologies!])+sum(monetary depreciation techn
[e techn!])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

monetary depreciation storage[storage technologies]=
	monetary capital storage[storage technologies]/storage lifetime[storage technologies
]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

monetary depreciation techn[e techn]=
	monetary capital techn[e techn]*(1/capacity lifetime[e techn])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

monetary investment=
	sum(storage capacity investment costs topay[storage technologies!])+sum(capacity investment costs topay
[e techn!])+grid investment
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

monetary investment storage[storage technologies]=
	storage capacity investment costs topay[storage technologies]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

monetary investment techn[e techn]=
	capacity investment costs topay[e techn]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

mortality rate cg[cohorts,gender]=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time=10*Year 1,
	initial mortality rate[cohorts,gender]*covid19 mortality impact 2020[cohorts,female]
,
	
	
	IF THEN ELSE(Time=11*Year 1 ,
	initial mortality rate[cohorts,gender]*covid mortality impact 2021[cohorts,female],
	
	initial mortality rate[cohorts,gender]))
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~		|

net worth banks=
	sum(debt i[ind!])
	-sum(d gs[gender!,skill!])
	-d cap
	+foreign assets
	~	Euro
	~		|

net worth firms=
	sum(K i[nongovsec!]*price capital pp i[nongovsec!])
	-sum(debt i[nongovsec!])
	-sum(Equity i[nongovsec!])
	
	
	-K i[electricity ind]*price capital pp i[electricity ind]
	
	+
	(
	(1-electricity module switch)*(K i[electricity ind]*price capital pp i[electricity ind
	])+
	electricity module switch*(K i[electricity ind]*price of capital D1 pp)
	)
	
	
	
	
	+sum(K i[govsec!]*(1-initial fraction government costs govsec[govsec!])*price capital pp i
[govsec!])
	-sum(debt i[govsec!])
	-sum(Equity i[govsec!])
	~	Euro
	~		|

net worth government=
	sum(K i[govsec!]*initial fraction government costs govsec[govsec!]*price capital pp i
[govsec!])
	-b
	~	Euro
	~		|

net worth households=
	sum(d gs[gender!,skill!])+d cap
	+sum(b gs[gender!,skill!])+b cap
	+sum(eq gs[gender!,skill!])+eq cap
	~	Euro
	~		|

net worth sum=
	sum(K i[ind!]*price capital pp i[ind!])
	
	-K i[electricity ind]*price capital pp i[electricity ind]
	
	+
	(
	(1-electricity module switch)*(K i[electricity ind]*price capital pp i[electricity ind
	])+
	electricity module switch*(K i[electricity ind]*price of capital D1 pp)
	)
	
	
	
	
	
	+foreign assets
	-net worth banks
	-net worth firms
	-net worth government
	-net worth households
	~	Euro
	~		|

num hhs r[regions]=
	sum(num hhs rq[regions,quintiles!])
	~	Household
	~		|

num hhs rq[regions,quintiles]=
	pop rq[regions,quintiles]/hhs members init[regions,quintiles]
	~	Household
	~		|

num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles]= DELAY FIXED (
	num hhs rq[regions,quintiles], delay time, num hhs rq init[regions,quintiles])
	~	Household
	~	(pop rq[regions,quintiles]/hhs members rq[regions,quintiles])
	|

num hhs rq init[regions,quintiles]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'regions', 'num_hhs_init_calib')
	~	Household
	~		|

NWB check=
	NWB total - total net labour income
	~	
	~		|

NWB rq[regions,quintiles]=
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,low]*L gis[female,ind!,low])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc low e f,quintiles
	] 
	+
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,low]*L gis[male,ind!,low])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc low e m,quintiles] +
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,mid]*L gis[female,ind!,mid])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc mid e f,quintiles
	] 
	+
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,mid]*L gis[male,ind!,mid])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc mid e m,quintiles] +
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,hig]*L gis[female,ind!,hig])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc hig e f,quintiles
	] 
	+
	sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,hig]*L gis[male,ind!,hig])*hhs cat shares rq adj
	[regions,inc hig e m,quintiles]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Net Wage Bill, total nominal value per region and quintile
	|

NWB rq 0[regions,quintiles]=
	NWB rq nuovoMADDI[regions,quintiles]
	~	
	~	Net Wage Bill, total nominal value per region and quintile
		
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,low]*L gis[female,ind!,low])*hhs \
		cat shares rq adj
		[regions,inc low e f,quintiles
		] 
		+
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,low]*L gis[male,ind!,low])*hhs cat \
		shares rq adj
		[regions,inc low e m,quintiles] +
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,mid]*L gis[female,ind!,mid])*hhs \
		cat shares rq adj
		[regions,inc mid e f,quintiles
		] 
		+
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,mid]*L gis[male,ind!,mid])*hhs cat \
		shares rq adj
		[regions,inc mid e m,quintiles] +
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[female,ind!,hig]*L gis[female,ind!,hig])*hhs \
		cat shares rq adj
		[regions,inc hig e f,quintiles
		] 
		+
		sum(net labour income per capita gis[male,ind!,hig]*L gis[male,ind!,hig])*hhs cat \
		shares rq adj
		[regions,inc hig e m,quintiles]
	|

	,basic omega price,Act Wage Indexation*Multiplier Wage Indexation
	))

ongoing investment financing[e techn]= INTEG (
	new capacity investment costs[e techn]-completely financed[e techn],
		0)
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	We assume a linear expense schedule of investment costs over the time of \
		construction.
	|

	sum(ongoing investment financing[e techn!]*capital price technology pp[e techn!])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

	~	Euro/Year
	~	OR

		]))

	~		|

other benefits per cap=
	(IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	             init other benefits per cap*CPI,
	             (1-Act BI)*init other benefits per cap*CPI
	             ))
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~		|

	other benefits per cap*pop d[inc low o f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low o f,
	quintiles] + 
	other benefits per cap*pop d[inc low o m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low o m,
	quintiles]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Total nominal income from other benefits per region-quintile
	|

output expected[ind]=
	y real delayed[ind]*(1+
	IF THEN ELSE(activated output expected covid shocks=1,output expected shocks[ind],
	output expected trend[ind]*expectations adjustment time))
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	output perceived[ind]*(1+output expected trend[ind]*(expectation \
		horizon+expectations adjustment time)
		The expected electricity demand based on trend based expectations. The \
		expectations adjustment time is added to the expectation horizon in the \
		exponent, as we use the perceived value as a basis. However, the perceived \
		value is already delayed by the expectations adjustment time, which is why \
		we add this time perdiod in the exponent. We simplify by ignoring \
		compounding of the growth rate, but as the time horizon is short, this is \
		a reasonable approximation.
	|

	~		|

	~		|

	IF THEN ELSE(active shocks time=1,
	0,
	
	(output perceived[ind]-output perceived delayed[ind])/output perceived delayed[ind]/
	expectations adjustment time)
	~	Dmnl
	~	The trend formed in the expectation formation for output.
		During times of strong shocks, trend is assumed to be 0

[ind]/

	[nrg,ind!,toind]))
	/(sum(a e before ESc[nrg,ind!,toind])+sum(a e imp before ESc[nrg,ind!,toind]))) ~~|

	)

[heat,toind,toind])) ~~|

	))))
	~	Dmnl

Policy time increment=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time < S Time Policy start,
	             0,
	             IF THEN ELSE(S Time Policy start = S Time Shift end,
	                          1,
	                          min(1, (Time-S Time Policy start+1)/(S Time Shift end-S Time Policy start
	+1))
	)
	)
	~	1
	~	Used to calculate linear increases of policy paramaters. It has a value of:
		- 0 before S Time Policy start
		- 1 after S Time Shift end
		- If policy implemented over multiple years, it grows linearly from 0 in S Time \
		Policy start to 1 in S Time Shift end
		When policy is implemented in 1 year (S Time Shift end = S Time Policy \
		start), value of 1 in first year
	|

potential demand met=
	IF THEN ELSE(storage shortfall for max generation<1,
	
	(max generation/(1+current storage share of demand*storage shortfall for max generation
*(1-overall storage efficiency))
	)
	-(1-storage shortfall for max generation)*overall storage efficiency*current storage share of demand
*(max generation/(1
	+current storage share of demand*(1-overall storage efficiency))),
	
	(max generation/(1+current storage share of demand*(1-overall storage efficiency))))
	~	GW*Hour/Year
	~	if sufficient storage, generation technologies determine potential production
		if not enough storage, less production is channeled through storage, i.e. \
		there are less losses; but also demand that normally is met by storage \
		cannot be met. We assume storage production deficit (and reduction in \
		losses) are proportional to the actual vs require storage share
	|

potential demand met expected=
	IF THEN ELSE(expectedstorage shortfall for max generation<1,
	
	(expectedmax generation/(1+expected storage share of demand[batteries]*expectedstorage shortfall for max generation
*(1-expectedoverall storage efficiency
	)))
	-(1-expectedstorage shortfall for max generation)*expectedoverall storage efficiency
*expected storage share of demand[batteries]*(
	expectedmax generation/(1+expected storage share of demand[batteries]*(1-expectedoverall storage efficiency
))),
	
	(expectedmax generation/(1+expected storage share of demand[batteries]*(1-expectedoverall storage efficiency
))))
	~	Hours*GW/Year
	~		|

	1
	~	Dmnl
	~	https://www.vensim.com/documentation/fn_allocate_by_priority.html
		"specifies how big a gap in priority is required to have the allocation go \
		first to higher priority with only leftovers going to lower priority.   \

		priority does not receive its full request the lower priority will receive \

sd rq[regions,quintiles]=
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low u f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low u f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low u m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low u m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid u f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid u f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid u m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid u m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig u f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig u f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig u m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig u m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low e f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low e f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low e m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low e m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid e f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid e f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid e m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid e m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig e f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig e f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig e m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig e m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low o f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low o f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc low o m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc low o m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid o f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid o f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc mid o m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc mid o m,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig o f]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig o f,quintiles] +
	sd per cap*pop d[inc hig o m]*hhs cat shares rq adj[regions,inc hig o m,quintiles]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Total sick and disability benefits per region-quintile

	2
	~	Year
	~	PHS same as hydro
		https://lorenz-g.github.io/tesla-megapack-tracker/all-big-batteries.html: \
		Sample of biggest batteries, none take longer than 12 months construction \
		time.

storage depreciation[storage technologies]=
	DELAY FIXED(storage capacity almost constructed investment[storage technologies], storage lifetime
[storage technologies] , (init storage capacity[storage technologies]/storage lifetime
[storage technologies]))
	~	GW/Year
	~	Storage depreciation, as a pipeline delay. Initial capacity linearly \
		depreciates and is fully depreciated, once the pipeline delay kicks in.
	|

storage discharge a[storage technologies]=
	storage charge a[storage technologies]*efficiency by storage technology[storage technologies
]
	~	GW*h/Year
	~		|

storage discharge deficit by technology[storage technologies]=
	storage charge deficit by technology[storage technologies]*efficiency by storage technology
[storage technologies]
	~	GW*h/Year
	~		|

storage expected investments ahead[storage technologies]=
	IF THEN ELSE(storage construction time[storage technologies]=2,
	storage investment delayed 1[storage technologies],
	
	IF THEN ELSE(storage construction time[storage technologies]=3,
	storage investment delayed 1[storage technologies]+storage investment delayed 2[storage technologies
],
	
	IF THEN ELSE(storage construction time[storage technologies]=4,
	storage investment delayed 1[storage technologies]+storage investment delayed 2[storage technologies
]+storage investment delayed 3[storage technologies],
	
	IF THEN ELSE(storage construction time[storage technologies]=5,
	storage investment delayed 1[storage technologies]+storage investment delayed 2[storage technologies
]+storage investment delayed 3[storage technologies]+storage investment delayed 4[storage technologies
],
	
	0)
	)
	)
	)
	~	GW/Year
	~		|

storage investment[storage technologies]=
	max(min(storage capacity investment desired[storage technologies],scale constraint multiplier
*storage max investment scale
	[storage technologies]),0)*financial constraint factor electricity
	~	GW/Year
	~	Actual investment in storage, desired investment is constrained by \
		financial resources and a maximum expansion of scale. These constraints \
		can be switched off/on.
	|

storage investment costs[storage technologies]=
	storage investment[batteries]*storage investment costs per unit capacity[storage technologies
]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	We assume a linear expense schedule of investment costs over the time of \
		construction. But since construction time is only 1 year all is being paid \
		at the moment of investment.
	|

storage investment costs per capacity initial[e hydro]=
	capacity investment costs per unit capacity initial[e hydro] ~~|
storage investment costs per capacity initial[power2gas]=
	p2g investment costs init ~~|
storage investment costs per capacity initial[batteries]=
	battery investment costs per capacity initial
	~	Euro constant/GW
	~		|

storage investment costs per unit capacity[e hydro]=
	capacity investment costs per unit capacity[e hydro] ~~|
storage investment costs per unit capacity[batteries]=
	battery investment costs per unit capacity ~~|

	p2g investment costs per unit capacity
	~	Euro constant/GW
	~		|

storage loss a=
	sum((1-efficiency by storage technology[storage technologies!])*storage charge a[storage technologies
!])
	~	GW*h/Year
	~		|

storage max investment scale[storage technologies]=
	max(max scale increase storage[storage technologies]*smooth(storage capacity[storage technologies
],scale impacts adjustment time
	),
	min max scale increase)
	~	GW/Year
	~	The maximum amount that capacity can increase within a year due to limited \
		production capabilities. This reflects, capital stock expansions are \
		limited by current infrastructure on the goround and that the larger the \
		capacity is, the larger its absolute increase can be due to more expansive \
		infrastructure. The smooth function reflects that this infrastructure does \
		not immediately materialise with added capacity, but slowly builds up over \
		time.
		battery capacity for learning init is not installed capacity in Italy but \
		taken from ETRI, 2014. Thus, we assume that scale effects initial refer to \
		this value until actual capacity exceeds it.
	|

storage new capacity investment costs[storage technologies]=
	storage investment costs[storage technologies]/storage construction time[storage technologies
]
	~	Euro constant/(Year*Year)
	~	We assume a linear expense schedule of investment costs over the time of \
		construction.
	|

	storage new capacity investment costs[storage technologies]-storage completely financed
[storage technologies],
		0)
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	We assume a linear expense schedule of investment costs over the time of \
		construction.
	|

	IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T3],3,
	IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T4],4,0)
	)))
	~	Dmnl
	~	Priority of technological choice:
		1. Labour constraint
		2. Costs
		IF THEN ELSE(factor capacity constraint i<1,capital prod techn[ind],
		
		IF THEN ELSE(factor FE constraint<1,lab saving techn[ind],
		
		
		IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T1],1,
		IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T2],2,
		IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T3],3,
		IF THEN ELSE(T i[ind]=UFC T iv[ind,T4],4,0)
		)))
		))
	|

	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

VA real estate=
	VA i[realestate]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

VA services=
	VA i[trade]+VA i[hospitality]+VA i[ict]+VA i[finance]+VA i[profserv]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

VA transport=
	VA i[transport]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

vat rate[ind]=
	(0.11)*IF THEN ELSE(Time<S Time Policy start,
	                1,
	                1+min(S Time end-S Time Policy start,Time-S Time Policy start)*(S vat rate
/(S Time end-S Time Policy start))
	                )
	~	percentage
	~	value added tax rates. Will keep the 11% (effective economy wide rate = \
		https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/GC.TAX.GSRV.VA.ZS?locations=IT )
		GET_DIRECT_CONSTANTS('economy.xlsx', 'government', 'vat_rates' )
	|

VRES growth19 23[e solarpv]=
	0.0957455 ~~|
VRES growth19 23[e wind]=
	0.0641986
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~	IEA electricity generation by source, mean growth rate 2019-2023
	|

VRES impact[e wind,electricity technologies]=
	VRES impact delayed[e wind,electricity technologies]*(1+VRES timing[e wind,electricity technologies
]*convergence factor elec late[electricity technologies]) ~~|
VRES impact[e solarpv,electricity technologies]=
	VRES impact delayed[e solarpv,electricity technologies]*(1+VRES timing[e solarpv,electricity technologies
]*convergence factor elec late[electricity technologies]
	)
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

VRES impact delayed[e wind,electricity technologies]= DELAY FIXED (
	 VRES impact[e wind,electricity technologies] , Year 1 , 1) ~~|
VRES impact delayed[e solarpv,electricity technologies]= DELAY FIXED (
	 VRES impact[e solarpv,electricity technologies] , Year 1 , 1)
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

VRES share[e techn] :EXCEPT:      [e wind],[e solarpv]=
	0 ~~|
VRES share[e wind]=
	(1-storage charge share)*production by technology b[e wind]/electricity demand ~~|
VRES share[e solarpv]=
	(1-storage charge share)*production by technology b[e solarpv]/electricity demand
	~	Dmnl
	~	VRES (i.e. wind and solar) share of electricity production directly fed \
		into the grid. Production that is used to charge storage is assumed to be \
		the same for all production technologies.
	|

VRES timing[e wind,electricity technologies]=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time+expectation horizon technology[electricity technologies]-Year 1+initial year
	>last year lookup tech share,
	
	VRES growth19 23[e wind],
	
	0) ~~|
VRES timing[e solarpv,electricity technologies]=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time+expectation horizon technology[electricity technologies]-Year 1+initial year
	>last year lookup tech share,
	
	VRES growth19 23[e solarpv],
	
	0)
	~	Dmnl
	~	IF THEN ELSE(Time+initial year+Year 1>phaseout year coal elec,
		VRES growth18 22[e wind],
		0)
	|

	~	Euro

w0=
	initial wealth per adult*sum(adult population s[skill!])/People 1
	~	Euro
	~	initial total national wealth.
	|

w0 s[skill]=
	initial wealth distribution per skill s[skill]*w0/euro 1
	~	Euro
	~	initial wealth by skill
	|

"w0\_cap"=
	w0-sum(w0 s[skill!])
	~	Euro [0,?]
	~	initial wealth held by capitalists
	|

WA cohorts:
	p1524,p2544,p4564
	~	
	~		|

wage adjustment constrain s[ind,skill]=
	min(IF THEN ELSE(y FE i[ind]<y FC i[ind] :AND: VMAX(labour scarcity s[skill!])=labour scarcity s
	[skill],
	wage scarcity adjustment[skill]*labour scarcity s[skill],
	0),max wage adjustment constrain)
	~	Dmnl
	~	Percentage increase in wages, caused by the constraint, applied to the most \
		constrained skill-level.
		
		industries only try to fill the most constrained skill level as this determines \
		employment of others
		if there is no labour scarcity, labour scarcity s is equal to 0.
	|

	VECTOR SORT ORDER(wage gis cat[wage cat], 1 )
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	wage gis cat[wage cat]*L gis wage cat[wage cat]/sum(wage gis cat[wage cat!]*L gis wage cat
[wage cat!])
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	~	Dmnl

wastebio share of nec no RES=
	IF THEN ELSE(Time+initial year<=last year wastebio shares,
	
	wastebio share of nec lookup(Time+initial year),
	
	wastebio share of nec lookup(last year wastebio shares))
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

	wastebio share of nec no RES+
	(wastebio share of nec final-wastebio share of nec no RES)/
	(1+EXP(-steepness logistic curve*(Time-midpoint logistic curve))))

WB aids adjusted intercepts[regions,quintiles,ind]=
	init beta i[regions,quintiles,ind]
	-WB aids income coefficients[ind]*ln(init yd hhs rq[regions,quintiles])
	-WB aids income squared coefficients[ind]*ln(init yd hhs rq[regions,quintiles])^2
	-sum(WB aids wb coefficients[ind,wellbeing!]*Initial wellbeing indicators[regions,quintiles
,wellbeing!])
	~	
	~		|

	~		|

	~	
	~		|

	~	
	~		|

	~	
	~		|

	max(0,WB aids adjusted intercepts[regions,quintiles,ind]
	+sum(WB aids price coefficients[ind,toind!]*ln(price index pp i delay[toind!]))
	+WB aids income coefficients[ind]*ln(expected yd rq real[regions,quintiles])
	+WB aids income squared coefficients[ind]*ln(expected yd rq real[regions,quintiles])
	^2)
	+sum(WB aids wb coefficients[ind,wellbeing!]*Wellbeing indicators rq[regions,quintiles\
		,wellbeing!])

	~		|

		(wage WTR gov total cost/sum(tot W[assets!])),0)

y nom i[ind]=
	y real i[ind]*p i[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Nominal output by industry
	|

	y real i[ind], Year 1, y real init[ind])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

y real delayed unconstrained[ind]= DELAY FIXED (
	y real unconstrained i[ind], Year 1, y real init[ind])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

y real i[ind]=
	sum(Leontief ii[ind,toind!]*final demand real i[toind!])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	21/05/24  y real unconstrained i[ind]*factor capacity constraint*factor FE constraint
		
		y real unconstrained i[ind]*factor capacity constraint*factor employment constraint
		
		Real output by industry: \
		min(sum(Leontief_ii[ind,toind!]*final_demand_real_i[toind!]),y_FC_i[ind])
	|

y real init[ind]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'inputoutput', 'Output*')
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

y real unconstrained i[ind]=
	sum(Leontief ii[ind,toind!]*desired domestic final demand real i[toind!])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	for capacity utilization
	|

yd d[inc cap]=
	NFI per capita cap
	+ mixed income per capita d[inc cap]
	+ CT redistrib per capita d delay[inc cap]
	+BI per capita received
	-wealth tax per capita cap
	~	Euro/(Year*Person)
	~	individual disposable income by income category
		
		per capita child benefits were previously computed as:
		(ZIDZ(cb gs[female,low],L u gs[female,low])*People 1)
		+(ZIDZ(cb gs[male,low],L u gs[male,low])*People 1)
		+(ZIDZ(cb gs[female,mid],L u gs[female,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,mid],L u gs[male,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,hig],L u gs[female,hig])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,hig],L u gs[male,hig])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,low],L gs[female,low])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,low],L gs[male,low])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,mid],L gs[female,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,mid],L gs[male,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,hig],L gs[female,hig])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,hig],L gs[male,hig])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,low],N olf gs[female,low])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,low],N olf gs[male,low])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,mid],N olf gs[female,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,mid],N olf gs[male,mid])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[female,hig],N olf gs[female,hig])*People 1)
		+ (ZIDZ(cb gs[male,hig],N olf gs[male,hig])*People 1)
	|

yd dynamic expectations perceived delayed adjustment[regions,quintiles]=
	(yd dynamic rq perceived[regions,quintiles]-yd dynamic rq perceived delayed[regions,
quintiles]

	~	Euro/(Year*Year*Household)
	~	Adjustement of perceived output delayed w.r.t. to output perceived.
	|

yd dynamic rq[regions,quintiles]=
	NWB rq[regions,quintiles] + 
	NUB rq[regions,quintiles] + 
	NPB rq[regions,quintiles] +
	NFI rq[regions,quintiles] +
	mixed income rq[regions,quintiles] +
	CT redistrib rq[regions,quintiles] -
	delta yd cap rq[regions,quintiles]+
	income cap redistribution hhs rq[regions,quintiles]*num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles
	]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

yd dynamic rq hh[regions,quintiles]=
	yd dynamic rq[regions,quintiles]/num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles]
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~		|

	quintiles]

	)

	~	The trend formed in the expectation formation for output.

yd hh after tls pre gini sum j[rq cat]=
	num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat]*
	sum(num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!] *
	ABS(yd shares rq cat after tls[rq cat]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat] - 
	yd shares rq cat after tls[rq cat j!]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!]))
	~	
	~		|

	sum(yd hh pre gini sum j[rq cat!])
	~	
	~		|

	~	
	~		|

	~		|

	~		|

	sum(num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat]*num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!] *
	ABS(yd shares rq cat[rq cat]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat] - 
	yd shares rq cat[rq cat j!]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!]))
	~	
	~		|

yd hh pre gini sum j nonMI[rq cat]=
	sum(num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat]*num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!] *
	ABS(yd shares rq cat nonMI[rq cat]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat] - 
	yd shares rq cat nonMI[rq cat j!]/num hhs delayed shares rq cat[rq cat j!]))
	~	
	~		|

	NWB rq[regions,quintiles] + 
	NUB rq[regions,quintiles] + 
	NPB rq[regions,quintiles] +
	NFI rq[regions,quintiles] +
	mixed income rq[regions,quintiles] +
	sd rq[regions,quintiles] +
	cb rq[regions,quintiles] +

	CT redistrib rq[regions,quintiles]
	-wealth tax rq[regions,quintiles]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Total nominal disposable income per region-quintile before eventual \
		taxation at the household level
	|
