yd shares rq nonMI[regions,quintiles]=
	(yd rq nonMI[regions,quintiles])/sum(yd rq nonMI[regions!,quintiles!])
	~	
	~		|

yd static rq[regions,quintiles]=
	sd rq[regions,quintiles] +
	cb rq[regions,quintiles] +
	other benefits rq[regions,quintiles]+
	BI rq[regions,quintiles] +
	JG rq n[regions,quintiles]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

yd static rq hh[regions,quintiles]=
	yd static rq[regions,quintiles]/num hhs rq delayed[regions,quintiles]
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~		|

yd static rq hh delay[regions,quintiles]= DELAY FIXED (
	yd static rq hh[regions,quintiles], Year 1, initial yd static rq hh
[regions,quintiles])
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~		|

yd static rq hh real delay[regions,quintiles]=
	yd static rq hh delay[regions,quintiles]/CPI rq delay[regions,quintiles
]
	~	Euro/(Year*Household)
	~		|

Year 0=
	0
	~	Year
	~		|

Year 1=
	1
	~	Year
	~		|

yearly exp adapt=
	1e+10
	~	Euro/Year
	~	1e+9 --> adaptation slow
		10e+9 --> adaptation fast
	|

ygross d[inc low u f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc low u m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid u f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid u m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig u f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig u m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc low e f]=
	GWB per capita gs[female,low]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc low e m]=
	GWB per capita gs[male,low]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid e f]=
	GWB per capita gs[female,mid]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid e m]=
	GWB per capita gs[male,mid]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig e f]=
	GWB per capita gs[female,hig]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig e m]=
	GWB per capita gs[male,hig]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc low o f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc low o m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid o f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid o m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig o f]=
	GFI per capita gs[female,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig o m]=
	GFI per capita gs[male,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc low p f]=
	gross annual income p gs[female,low]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc low p m]=
	gross annual income p gs[male,low]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,low] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid p f]=
	gross annual income p gs[female,mid]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc mid p m]=
	gross annual income p gs[male,mid]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,mid] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig p f]=
	gross annual income p gs[female,hig]
	+GFI per capita gs[female,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc hig p m]=
	gross annual income p gs[male,hig]
	+GFI per capita gs[male,hig] ~~|
ygross d[inc cap]=
	GFI per capita cap
	~	Euro/People
	~	individual market disposable income by income category. The idea here is \
		to remove all tax and transfers. We devided to leave Pensions.
	|

	VECTOR SORT ORDER(ygross d[inc cat], 1 )
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

ygross share[inc cat]=
	(ygross d[inc cat]*pop d[inc cat])/(sum(ygross d[inc cat!]*pop d[inc cat!]))
	~	Dmnl
	~		|

Z cell import share trend[ind,toind]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'technology', 'trend_impsh_Z')
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~	Geometric mean of growth rates of import shares, for the period 2000-2014 \
		(excluding 2008-2010), computed from input-output data. Sectors D1, D2 and \
		D3 take the same value of sector D in input-output tables.
	|

Z cell import share trend capped[ind,toind]=
	max(min(Z cell import share trend[ind,toind],trend cap),-trend cap)
	~	Dmnl/Year
	~		|

z demand i[toind]=
	sum(Z nom ii[ind!,toind])+Z imp nom i[toind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	intermediate demand by industry including imports, nominal
	|

Z domestic production main producer=
	sum(E Z nrgii[elec,electricity ind,ind!])
	~	TJ/Year
	~		|

Z imp nom i[toind]=
	sum(p imp i delay[ind!]*Z imp real ii[ind!,toind])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

Z imp real from i[ind]=
	sum(Z imp real ii[ind,toind!])
	~	
	~		|

Z imp real i[ind]=
	sum(Z imp real ii[ind,toind!])
	~	
	~	Sum of import inputs per unit of output of each toind, at prices of the first period \
		(price equal to one).
		Needed for computing real GDP.
	|

Z imp real ii[ind,toind]=
	share imp Z ESc ii[ind,toind] * Z real ii[ind,toind]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

Z imp real tot=
	sum(Z imp real ii[ind!,toind!])
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

Z nom ii[ind,toind]=
	Z real ii[ind,toind]*p i[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~	Interindustry trade matrix, nominal
	|

Z nom initial ii[ind,toind]=
	GET XLS CONSTANTS('?main', 'inputoutput', 'znominit')
	~	Euro
	~		|

Z real i[toind]=
	sum(Z real ii[ind!,toind])
	~	
	~		|

Z real ii[ind,toind]=
	a ii[ind,toind]*y real i[toind]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~	Interindustry trade matrix, real
		
		Before: exception for [ind,finance]
		IF THEN ELSE(Financial income switch=0,
		            a ii[ind,finance]*y real i[finance],
		            sum(ZIDZ(Financial industry revenue i[ind!],CPI))
		            )
	|

Z real ind[ind]=
	sum(Z real ii[ind,toind!])
	~	
	~	production of each industry used for intermediate demand
	|

Z T demand iv[toind,techn]=
	sum(z T nom total iiv[ind!,toind,techn])
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

z T nom imp iiv[ind,toind,techn]=
	z T real imp iiv[ind,toind,techn]*p imp i delay[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

z T nom total iiv[ind,toind,techn]=
	z T nom imp iiv[ind,toind,techn]+z T real iiv[ind,toind,techn]*p i[ind]
	~	Euro/Year
	~		|

z T real iiv[ind,toind,techn]=
	a T iiv[ind,toind,techn]*output expected[toind]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|

z T real imp iiv[ind,toind,techn]=
	share imp Z ESc ii[ind,toind]*factor imp shareee T current[ind,toind,techn] * z T real iiv
[ind,toind,techn]
	~	Euro constant/Year
	~		|
